lyrics:
[Intro: acoustic guitar, whistled tune, boot stomps]

[Verse 1: laid-back male baritone, guitar and stomps]
Boss sent an email at a quarter to five
Marked it "urgent," like the building's on fire
Truck needs a belt and my back needs a break
And my thumb's got a blister from the scrolling it takes

[Pre-Chorus: fiddle slides in, drums pick up]
So I walked in the door and Darlene said, "Hon,
You know the house rule. Hand it over. Go on."

[Chorus: gang vocals, low 808 thump, fiddle hook]
Put your phone in the tip jar (hey!)
Let it buzz with the quarters and ones
Whoever's looking, let 'em look
We'll call 'em back when the night is done
Got a jukebox, got a stool, got a long old bar
So put your phone in the tip jar

[Verse 2: baritone, band grooving]
There's a plumber, a teacher, a nurse off a twelve
A kid with a ring he ain't shown to the girl
An old man toasting to a chair that's bare
We don't ask a thing, we just pull up a chair

[Pre-Chorus: fiddle climbing]
And the jar fills up like a church plate does
Darlene says, "Y'all, that's what I call love"

[Chorus: gang vocals, low 808 thump, fiddle hook]
Put your phone in the tip jar (hey!)
Let it buzz with the quarters and ones
Whoever's looking, let 'em look
We'll call 'em back when the night is done
Got a jukebox, got a stool, got a long old bar
So put your phone in the tip jar

[Bridge: half-time, whole room singing]
It can wait (it can wait)
It can wait (it can wait)
Every little red dot, every "running late"
It can wait

[Final Chorus: loudest, stomps and claps, fiddle on top]
Put your phone in the tip jar (hey!)
Let it buzz with the quarters and ones
Whoever's looking, let 'em look
We'll call 'em back when the night is done
Got a jukebox, got a stool, got a long old bar
So put your phone in the tip jar

[Outro: guitar and whistle, one phone ringing, spoken]
Darlene, whose is that?
Yours, hon. It's your wife. Go home.
